papers.title: Dr. Claw: An AI Scientist Workspace for Vibe Research
papers.desc: Command-line coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini CLI) can already read and write files and sustain long sessions, yet end-to-end research still fragments across chat tools, IDEs, terminals, and writing environments, and the decisions that make it auditable are rarely preserved.

papers.title: Unlocking Lossless Speedups in LLMs via Discrete Diffusion
papers.desc: Large Language Models (LLMs) owe much of their success to next-token prediction (NTP), but their autoregressive (AR) structure requires slow, sequential token generation.

papers.title: FlowBalance: Verifier-Grounded Self-Improvement from On-Policy Reasoning Experience
papers.desc: A reasoning model can improve from its own on-policy experience, but this inner loop is fragile: terminal verifiers provide reliable yet sparse supervision, while dense same-model guidance can reinforce false confidence or overconcentrate learning on a narrow solution mode.

papers.title: ENEAS: Embedding-guided Neural Ensemble for Adaptive Segmentation
papers.desc: We present ENEAS, a unified, text-promptable method for instance tracking and semantic discovery.

papers.title: One Symptom, Three Levers: A Critical Review of On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.desc: On-policy distillation trains a language model on its own generations while a teacher scores them token by token.

papers.title: EmbodiedSkills: A Unified Framework for Orchestrating, Training, and Deploying VLA Agents
papers.desc: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but long-horizon tasks require more than action prediction.

papers.title: Verify Before You Distill: Prompt-Level Teacher Gating for On-Policy Distillation
papers.desc: On-policy distillation (OPD) accelerates post-training by providing dense token-level supervision from a frozen teacher on the student's own rollouts.

papers.title: Unfold The World: Factorize 4D Properties in Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning
papers.desc: Despite the remarkable prowess of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in general multimodal tasks, they remain fundamentally ``flat'' when reasoning about the physical world.

papers.title: Knowing What Not to Answer: Selective Non-Compliance in Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to respond helpfully to appropriate requests while withholding compliance with requests that are incorrect, unsafe, infeasible, or unanswerable.

papers.title: Causal Foundation Models
papers.desc: Causal inference is the practice of estimating the effect of a treatment or intervention from data.

papers.title: Safety for Whom? Boundary-Aware Self-Distillation for Controlled LLM Safety Refusal
papers.desc: Safety alignment is usually posed as a topic-level question: is this subject harmful? Deployments ask a narrower one.

papers.title: What Else Needs Fixing? Exploring Cost-Effective Test-Time Compute for Revision Propagation in Artifacts Generated Through Conversation
papers.desc: Large Language Models (LLMs) often help users generate artifacts through iterative cycles of generation and revision in conversation.

papers.title: Real-World Knowledge-Guided Change Data Synthesis for Remote Sensing
papers.desc: Change data synthesis provides a cost-effective solution for expanding training data and improving the performance of change detection models.

papers.title: HarvestBench: Measuring Whether LLM Agents Will Pay to Avoid Killing Animals
papers.desc: Benchmarks for the side effects an agent causes on the way to a goal already exist, but HarvestBench is the first to put a price on avoiding the side effect and to name that side effect as a living creature.

papers.title: Unifying Conformal Language Tasks with In-Context Ensembles
papers.desc: Many NLP tasks, such as summarization and extractive question answering, reduce to retrieving relevant content from documents under two constraints: coverage, retaining enough pertinent information to achieve some goal, and conciseness, removing as much irrelevant information as possible.
